reviewer: root independent AI review after both agents delivered
conclusion: No speedup demonstrated on this small simple-metal vector drafting task; traditional workflow faster in this paired run.

visual_findings: SAM A contains long narrow edge incursions even after self-intersection repair; traditional is a simpler straight envelope.
SAM B shaft at native y1740 is approximately2.62px vs traditional7px; these are candidate widths, not measured physical truth.
C1/C2 separate in both, with consistent broad structure. SAM includes more texture-following small contour details.
Both complete native candidate polygons; neither is approved orthogonal design geometry or electrical reconstruction.

limitations: Single same-chip pair; four selected simple targets; no repeated randomized crossover.
Different agents and service latency confound general method speed claims.
Both exclude shared setup and prior SAM installation; include each branch code/preparation/checks.
Probe labels are source-inspected AI judgments, not human ground truth.12/12 does not establish dense accuracy.
No human correction time measured; human review or adoption still separate.
recommendation: Keep traditional workflow for current small structured geometry tasks; retain SAM as optional contour evidence, do not promote it to default based on this trial.
